task.title: Replacing a returned cheque with a direct deposit payment

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li:
In SPS, select Returns & Duplicates in the Main Menu and Advice Notice Instructions in the Screen menu to issue a replacement payment as follows:
Payment Reference Number: Enter the 12-digit payment reference number.
Click Go .
Address: Enter the client’s new address in capital letters.
Postal Code: Enter the client’s new postal code in capital letters.
Country: Select the appropriate option.
Financial Institution: Enter the financial institution number.
Branch: Enter the branch number.
FI Account Number: Enter the account number.
Verify that the client’s name is correct. Click Submit .
Verify that the information entered is correct. Click Confirm .
No further action is required.
Note
